description:
Goal
Fix the current enum_map_family native failure: direct closure fast-path lowering calls a target with more call arguments than its logical parameter surface accepts.

Current signal
The old ReturnLanes arity-mismatch examples are no longer current: no_parens_do, no_parens_keyword, and map_enumerable pass direct run/build checks. The remaining fixture covered by this bucket is enum_map_family:

  fz2 run fixtures2/behavior/enum_map_family.fz

Current failure:

  direct closure target fn 57 cannot receive 2 call args through only 1 logical params

The interpreter path completes and prints the expected map-family output; the native path panics in src/compiler2/native_codegen/driver.rs during direct closure target validation.

Required work
- Narrow the enum_map_family case to the smallest Enum helper/lambda shape that trips the native direct-closure fast path.
- Fix native lowering so direct closure calls only use the fast path when captured lanes and call arguments match the selected executable's logical parameter surface.
- If the call is polymorphic or requires a callable boundary, route it through the correct boundary instead of forcing the direct path.
- Update fixture defers that still mention the old ReturnLanes failure once the native paths pass.

Checks
- Focused native regression for the minimized direct-closure arity case.
- cargo run --bin fz2 -- run fixtures2/behavior/enum_map_family.fz matches the golden.
- cargo test --lib and cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings.
title: Native enum_map_family direct closure fast path passes too many args
